summary_1line: During Janamejaya’s snake sacrifice, Indra abandons Takshaka as mantras drag him toward the fire, but Astika asks the king to end the sacrifice.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra appears in a radiant chariot surrounded by gods and clouds while the terrified serpent Takshaka hides in his upper garment.
Takshaka, cast off by Indra, spins helplessly in the sky as the sacrificial mantras pull him toward the blazing altar below.
Young sage Astika stands before King Janamejaya at the sacrificial arena, raising his hand to request that the snake sacrifice be stopped.
